name: ws_small_y
description: Website Services Small Y colorway styles.
author: YMCA Website Services

scripts.css:submodule: echo "Building ${npm_config_module}" && cd ./modules/${npm_config_module} && if [ ! -f "./package.json" ]; then echo "No package.json here."; else npm install && npm run build; fi
scripts.css:submodules: modules=$(cat ./package.json | jq -r '.config.modules[]'); for module in $modules; do (npm run css:submodule --module="$module"); done
scripts.css:build: npm run css:compile && npm run css:prefix && npm run css:submodules
